effect_scope: Exploratory primary contextual AP contrast only; no event-alarm acceptance
limitations: Same previously viewed processed cohort; all contrasts exploratory and intervals unadjusted.
Missing complete timestamps: row support is nominal, not proven temporal or prospective validation; no alarm/day or event metrics.
Source IOB is a unitless past-injection activity index, not remaining insulin dose.
Context requires diary entries; missing fields and zeros do not establish true absence of injections or food.
Personal training and validation require earlier source-reference labels. Calibration uses the same validation segment used in model/threshold selection; no separate calibration cohort.
Point-level observed-reference opportunity fraction is not true sensor uptime; no actual device measurement-coverage claim.
